title: VisualStyle candidate group-code value-width descriptor guard
scope: Bind candidate VISUALSTYLE source fields and candidate DXF group codes to the generic value types declared by Autodesk's DXF group-code table
Check group presence against the existing R2010 specified/unresolved/not-applicable partition
Retain all R2013b slot mappings and serializer admissions as unresolved

assertions: every non-null R2010, R2013b candidate, peer companion, and importer-candidate group has a recognized generic value-type range
R2010 specified and unresolved slots have group candidates; not-applicable extension slots do not
each R2013b candidate slot retains a candidate code while its semantic assignment remains unresolved
all R2013b serializer admissions remain unresolved and serializer admission remains denied

evidenceLimits: Autodesk's generic group-code ranges establish only the encoded value type/width associated with a code, not the meaning of that code at a particular VisualStyle slot.
The R2013b group assignments remain LibreDWG-derived candidates; same primary tag sequence observations do not establish producer semantics.
This guard does not resolve groups 31/33/45, group-176 companion meaning, group 177, CMC encoding, owner closure, or native acceptance.
The existing manifest/vector checks and this type-width guard do not enable a VisualStyle serializer or promote DWG/DXF support.
